description: NaVH₂(OF₂)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form corner-sharing NaOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 62°. The Na-O bond length is 2.40 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.39 Å. V is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one O and four F atoms. The V-O bond length is 1.60 Å. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.89 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one V atom. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom.
